Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left,
reporting right knee pain and limited range of motion. Over the course of 17 visits,
treatment included physical examination, imaging review, a structured physical therapy
program, and activity modification. The mechanism of injury described is consistent
with the reported knee complaints. Examination revealed findings that support a
meaningful knee injury, including tenderness along the joint line and reduced flexion,
while sevreal other tests, including ligament stability assessments, were within
normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region is known to this provider. Care
followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and function
improved and the patient was discharged to a home exercise program. Billing records
reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate
entries.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
